cohort: Participants were 470 newborns whose mothers gave birth during the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020 and received care in three public hospitals in Brazil.
finding: Inadequate birth weight was associated with prematurity, delivery type, lower gestational weight gain, and maternal physical inactivity during the COVID-19 pandemic.
mod_finding: Low birth weight was more often observed in children delivered by cesarean sections.
birth_weight: Birth weight, categorized as low and insufficient, was assessed.
gest_age: Prematurity was identified as a significant factor affecting birth weight.
